question_en: (Our team's own challenge, not a question) Broker listed a boat with more than the agreed 5% discount on its website. Our reply was to correct it.
answer_exact: It appears that the terms of our agreement are not being followed. Could you please clarify why the price has been reduced by more than 5%? I am specifically referring to our Vallejo for the week of June 7th. As per our agreement, we are offering the boat at a price of 4200 EUR. ... So, it's been two weeks, and no simple limitation has been set on our account to prevent promoting yachts with more than a 5% discount? Unfortunately, until this issue is resolved, I will have to disable your account from MMK. ... It seems to be okay now! We will be in touch for any future issue.

answered_by: Thalia Zakinthinou / George Kritikos / Ileana Dallos

statement: IonionSails enforced the 5% maximum discount: in March 2025 the team found Searadar listings on MMK discounted more than 5% (an extra -8%) for a Vallejo week 7 to 14 June priced at EUR 4,200, and threatened to disable the broker's MMK account until corrected.

A broker that breaks the 5% discount rule can have its MMK account disabled by us until the problem is fixed. A second breach in Sept 2026 was tolerated once with the warning that the booking would be refused if it happened again.

Example price: Vallejo for the week 7-14 June 2025 offered at 4,200 EUR. A broker site showing -8% instead of the agreed maximum 5% led IonionSails to threaten disabling the broker's account in MMK (booking manager) until fixed.
